title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - Nigeria (01-Jan-2017-30-Jun-2019)

description.narrative: Nigeria, HIV, Family Health International (FHI360) (FHI 360)This program has the following goals: To contribute to the restoration of public confidence in primary health care services in Nigeria, and thereby reverse declines in the utilization of primary health care facilities. To provide Nigerians with universal access to high-quality, patient-centred prevention, diagnosis, and treatment services for TB, TB/HIV, and drug-resistant TB by 2020.. To reduce new HIV infections, and improve the quality of life for the infected and affected.. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: At least 80% of most at-risk-populations accessing HIV counselling and testing by 2020. Objective 2: PMTCT: At least 90% of all HIV positive pregnant women have access to more efficacious ARV prophylaxis by 2020. Objective 3: ART: At least 70% of eligible adults (women and men) and 70% of children (boys and girls) are receiving ART based on national guidelines by 2017 (Consolidated Target setting meeting, 2014). Objective 4: Achieve an increase in the Case Notification Rate of all forms of TB from 57.3 per 100,000 population in 2013 to 287 per 100,000 population in 2020. Objective 5: To increase treatment success rate from 86% in 2013 to of 90% by 2020 among drug-susceptible patients.. Objective 6: Enroll 100% of diagnosed DR-TB patients on appropriate treatment by 2020

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for NGA-H-FHI360P01
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
TB/HIV-4: Percentage of new HIV-positive patients starting IPT during the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Number of people who were tested for HIV and received their results during the reporting period
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of HIV-positive patients who were screened for TB in HIV care or treatment settings
Percentage of people living with HIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy
TB/HIV-other 1: Number of HIV + incident TB cases that received treatment for TB and HIV
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings
Impact indicators targets and results for NGA-H-FHI360P01
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
Outcome indicators targets and results for NGA-H-FHI360P01
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
